faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Yes, all tutorials are completely free, just like our tools. No registration or payment required.
faq.q2: Do I need to install any software?
faq.a2: No, all tutorials use our web-based tools. You only need a modern web browser.
faq.a3: Currently, tutorials are available online. We're working on downloadable PDF versions.
faq.q4: How often are new tutorials added?
faq.a4: We add new tutorials weekly, especially for new tools and feature updates.
faq.q5: Can I request a specific tutorial?
faq.a5: Yes! Use our 'Suggest Tutorial Topic' button above to request specific tutorials.
faq.q6: Are the tutorials available in other languages?
faq.a6: Currently available in English. We plan to add Urdu and other languages soon.
